test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

My teacher asked me to __compress__ the file.
solution:
The correct answer is **Enlarge.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate antonym of the underlined word is Enlarge.
 
• **Compress **means **squeeze or press to flatten by pressure**.
 
• Thus
